what: One iPhone build, walked four times, with the simulator put back between every walk. Nothing about the app changed between these four walks; anything that differs is the noise a paired run would have to live with.
device: an iPhone 17 Pro simulator on iOS 27.0, made by the adapter for itself
howPutBack: the app and everything it had written removed, and every permission it had been granted taken back
